title: Read-only adoption transaction for one model discovered in an existing Ollama install
description: Written by `clozn adopt ollama` (clozn.cli.commands.adopt) when it registers one Ollama model into Clozn's own model directory. This document IS the transaction record `--undo` reads back -- it is never written for a --dry-run. Every optional field is omitted, never null, when Clozn could not honestly determine it (e.g. a cloud-only Ollama model has no source_blob_path). Adoption never writes into Ollama's own storage; this schema only ever describes what Clozn itself created.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this transaction was written.

discovery.description: Provenance of how Ollama was found -- clozn.adopt.ollama_discovery.discover()'s result. An API-sourced discovery (env/endpoint) is higher-confidence than executable or storage_fallback (see that module's docstring).

host.description: The Ollama API base URL that answered, when discovery was API-sourced.

version.description: Ollama's own reported version string, when available.

ollama.description: What Clozn read about the model FROM Ollama. Nothing in this object was ever written back to Ollama.

model_name.description: The model name exactly as Ollama reports it (e.g. 'qwen2.5:7b-instruct').

manifest_digest.description: The `digest` field Ollama's /api/tags reports for this model. Its exact scope (image-config digest vs. weight-blob digest) is a documented uncertainty of this integration -- it is recorded for provenance and must not be assumed equal to source_blob_sha256.

source_blob_path.description: Absolute path to the blob Clozn resolved as this model's weights, parsed from the `FROM` line of Ollama's own /api/show 'modelfile' text. Absent when no local blob could be resolved (e.g. a cloud-only model).

source_blob_sha256.description: SHA-256 Clozn itself computed by reading source_blob_path's bytes at adoption time -- ground truth independent of manifest_digest, used by --undo to detect drift/GC of the Ollama-side source.

blob_digest.description: Exact model-layer digest read from Ollama's manifest, distinct from manifest_digest.

manifest_path.description: Read-only manifest used to select the exact model layer.

clozn.description: What Clozn created. Always a NEW entry under Clozn's own model directory; never a write into Ollama's tree.

registered_name.description: The name this adoption is registered under, e.g. 'ollama/qwen2.5:7b-instruct'.

path.description: Absolute path Clozn created under its own model directory.

mode.description: How `path` was created. 'external_read_only' (register the source path directly, no new file) and 'symlink' are described in the spec's strategy ladder but not implemented in this release -- see clozn/cli/commands/adopt.py's module docstring.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of path's bytes at adoption time. Equals source_blob_sha256 for both hard_link and copy modes (a hard link is the same bytes; a copy is verified byte-identical before this transaction is written).

template.description: How Clozn translated and verified this model's Ollama-side template, parameters, and system prompt. Components record exact reproduction, translation, absence, or unsupported input separately; exactly_reproduced is true only when every present component can be reproduced exactly, and warnings preserve any uncertainty.

engine_capability.description: Header-derived capability discovered before adoption. This field remains 'discovered'; when `--qualify` runs the deterministic runtime smoke check, its separate result is recorded in the qualification property and may establish 'core' capability.
